column1: # TLA: vendor C functions whose definitions the wasm build drops because port/pc defines a replacement

column3: reads the chip id through a RAM copy of a Thumb routine in flash command mode; our flash answers as an SST chip (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
programs through flash command sequences and status polling of the chip; ours writes the 4 KB sector of the emulated flash (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
chip command sequence + polling; ours fills the 64 KB with 0xff (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
sector command sequence + polling; ours fills the sector with 0xff (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
runs ReadFlashCore from a halfword copy on the stack (no wasm function there); ours copies directly (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
runs VerifyFlashCore from a stack copy; ours compares directly, same result (TLA2b: the TLA driver has the same API and SST path)
